newsitem.title: USA: Rykoff-Sexton FY97 EPS outlook unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Rykoff-Sexton FY97 EPS outlook unchanged.

text.p: Rykoff-Sexton Inc, which distributes food and other products to restaurants and institutions, said it is too early to make any revisions to its fiscal 1997 earnings estimate of $0.50 to $0.60 a share.
Earlier, Rykoff posted earnings for the first quarter ended September 28 of $0.07 a share after $0.09 in goodwill. The company said these results were somewhat stronger than anticipated.
The company said "excellent progress" is being made integrating the operations of US Foodservice, which was acquired in May 1996.

The company completed, ahead of schedule, the closing and consolidation of four overlapping distribution centers, with a fifth consolidation in prgoress. After the end of the first quarter, three additional distribution centers were closed.

Rykoff added it received an award in an arbitration proceeding involving the sale of its Tone Brothers Inc subsidiary in October 1994. The award was not material and will not impact company results, it added.
